title: 新闻 · 城市图书馆延长开放
sentences: Good evening. In local news tonight, the city council has announced that the central library will extend its opening hours starting next month.
From now on, the library will stay open until ten o'clock every evening, including weekends.
Officials say the change is a response to growing demand from students and night-shift workers who need a quiet place to study.
The extended hours will be funded by a small increase in the city's cultural budget.

The extended hours will be funded by a small increase in the city's cultural budget.

questions.explanation: 原文 growing demand from students and night-shift workers，选 C。

title: 讲座 · 记忆的工作原理
sentences: Today we'll look at how human memory actually works, and why forgetting is not always a flaw.
Our brains receive far more information than they could ever store, so they constantly decide what to keep and what to discard.
Information that is repeated, emotionally meaningful, or connected to what we already know is much more likely to be remembered.
This is why simply rereading your notes is far less effective than testing yourself, a technique psychologists call retrieval practice.
By forcing your brain to pull information out, you strengthen the memory far more than by passively putting information in.

Our brains receive far more information than they could ever store, so they constantly decide what to keep and what to discard. This is why simply rereading your notes is far less effective than testing yourself, a technique psychologists call retrieval practice. By forcing your brain to pull information out, you strengthen the memory far more than by passively putting information in.

Automakers plan to invest heavily in fast-charging networks over the next three years.

title: 讲座 · 气候政策
sentences: Today's lecture examines how nations design climate policies that balance economic growth with environmental protection.
Carbon pricing is one widely debated tool: it makes polluters pay for emissions, creating an incentive to innovate.
Critics argue that without international cooperation, carbon taxes may simply shift production to countries with weaker rules.
Supporters counter that regional agreements can still drive meaningful change if major economies lead by example.
Students should note that effective policy rarely relies on a single measure; it combines regulation, investment, and public education.

title: 讲座 · 文学与现实
sentences: In this session we explore why realistic fiction continues to attract readers in an age of fantasy blockbusters.
Realistic novels often focus on ordinary people facing believable conflicts, which helps readers reflect on their own lives.
Some scholars argue that realism lost influence in the twentieth century, yet contemporary authors still return to everyday settings.
The key is not whether a story contains magic, but whether its emotions feel truthful.
By examining recent prize-winning novels, we can see how realism adapts rather than disappears.
